boundary: WSL cleanup job (wsl.yml via the gatekeeper)
evidence: Cleanup script written 2026-10-27 with WSLCLEAN_* markers: per-target du before/after, df before/after, journal vacuum target 200 MB, age thresholds 7d (/tmp, /var/tmp) and 30d (~/.cache), fstrim last
First run held until the WSL health probe verdict (launch failure 0x8007274c voided every WSL run in that window)
falsification_tests: A cleanup marker set missing any in-scope target
A cleanup that runs without before/after sizes
claims.text: The cleanup job clears apt cache, vacuums the journal to 200 MB, ages out /tmp, /var/tmp (>7d) and user cache (>30d), trims, and reports before/after sizes as markers.

evidence: Script uses sudo -n and degrades to user-level targets, stating the degradation in its markers
falsification_tests: A cleanup report claiming privileged targets cleaned on a run where sudo was unavailable
claims.text: Privileged steps degrade honestly when non-interactive sudo is unavailable; markers state the degradation.

evidence: Script contains no docker prune and no autoremove; Docker is queried for size only (docker system df)
Fleet preserve lists collected 2026-10-27 name the untouchable trees (campaign state, custody copies, pinned caches, the pinned xilinx/edf image)
falsification_tests: Any preserve-list path modified by the cleanup job
Any docker prune or autoremove executed by the cleanup job
claims.text: Cleanup never touches project trees, preserve-list paths, or Docker data (report-only), and never removes packages.

boundary: agent discretion under the operator's 2026-10-27 grant
evidence: Operator's words 2026-10-27: 'the agent itself (you) may choose to do more cleanups before the image compact'
falsification_tests: An added target outside the OS-cache class without a cleanup-gate claim
claims.text: The agent may extend cleanup only within the OS-cache class before a compact; anything else goes through the cleanup gate.

evidence: Procedure written in the program runbook (WSL-MANAGEMENT.md) 2026-10-27; precedent: owner-run compact 2026-10-12 returned ~185 GB, verified by vhdx file sizes
falsification_tests: A compact run without prior scheduling and announcement
A compact claimed from in-distro free space without host-side image sizes
claims.text: Compact follows cleanup → trim → shutdown → host-side optimization → verification by df and image sizes, and is owner-scheduled and announced in advance.
